short_description: Austrian digital-therapeutic company, founded in 2018 in Klosterneuburg (Lower Austria) by Daniel Amann and Prof. Dr. Lukas Pezawas, operating under the legal entity SOFY GmbH. Edupression develops and markets a CE-certified, prescription-eligible digital psychotherapy program (mobile and web app) for unipolar depression and burnout, co-developed with the Medical University of Vienna and evaluated in multiple randomized clinical studies. The product has received permanent listing in Germany's DiGA directory for prescription digital-therapeutics.
